advisory_evidence: RECONSTRUCTED_PETROLEUM_PROPERTIES: frozen TJL19 reconstruction, not original HYSYS properties; 60 F standard-liquid basis assumed
ESTIMATED_HEAVY_RESIDUE: empirical critical-property extrapolation retained for flagged petroleum fractions
THERMAL_FIT: degree-five Cp fit, analytic H relative to 298.15 K; validated over 298.15..900 K
PR78_MODEL_DIFFERENCE: V3 low-omega coefficient 1.54226; reconstruction source 1.5422
METHANE_EXTENSION: NIST ideal-gas Cp fit; CoolProp PR constants; methane binary interactions assumed zero, not fitted
METHANE_ASSAY: synthetic 0.5 mol% methane blend; hypothetical liquid-density metadata is unused by the molar feed and PR equations
NITROGEN_EXTENSION: initial charge is conserved inventory; nitrogen/hydrocarbon PR interactions estimated zero; no nitrogen dissolution in the separate free-water phase.

NITROGEN_CRYOGENIC: valid from its 63.151 K triple point (ideal-gas Cp held below 273.16 K, within 0.05 % of NIST; NIST viscosity tables); PR78 Psat at 77.355 K +1.21 %, liquid density -0.07 % against NIST (F4, P3 WP4 direct liquid path)
ESTIMATED_REGROUPING: PC08-12 mass/volume-constrained Tia Juana reconstruction; heavy Tc/Pc extrapolated; global Dalia transport

REFINERY_COMPOUNDS: the 24 Tier 1 compounds of REFINERY_COMPOUNDS_REVIEW.md P1 (batch 2026-11-04-refinery-compounds), ChemSep v8.3 records embedded in DWSIM 10.2.5 (Kooijman and Taylor, Artistic License 2.0), credited per record; tools/compound-import

REFINERY_PAIRS: icheme:dwsim_refinery_pr78 holds only pairs with a new compound (D3): DWSIM kij_pr.dat, else the DECHEMA pr_ip.dat value nearest 300..600 K, else zero; Methane/HydrogenSulfide 0.08125 from ChemSep pr.ipd; existing pairs unchanged

HYDROGEN_PAIRS_ZERO: every hydrogen pair is zero by rule (owner, 2026-11-04): the narrow-range DECHEMA fits would put hydrogen into the oil; H2 and H2S solubility in oil at k_ij = 0 is a known simplification
COS_CONSTANTS: carbonyl sulfide on CoolProp 8.0.0 Tc 378.77 K, Pc 6.3688 MPa and omega 0.0978 (Lemmon and Span 2006, owner decision D4b); ChemSep correlations otherwise; triple-point pressure omitted

ESTIMATED_DATA_ENDS: ideal-gas Cp fitted from each compound's ChemSep data start (or triple point) to 900 K and held past its ends; liquid viscosity past the ChemSep data end continued at the Andrade slope, marked estimated; appearances estimated
